name: BeeEye Live
author: BeeEye
description: Mirrors BeeEye-gui's live packet analyzer in the Omarchy bar: capture status, packet/byte counters and kernel drops, and a rolling feed of the most recent packets, all polled from the analyzer's local HTTP API (no capture logic duplicated here). Read-only — starting/stopping capture and deep packet inspection stay in the full analyzer, which one click opens in the browser.

barWidget.description: Live packet counters and a recent-packets feed pulled from BeeEye-gui, the home-network analyzer's Wireshark-style live capture UI.

schema.label: Analyzer URL
schema.description: Base URL of the BeeEye-gui live analyzer. Defaults to the local gateway's port 8081 — change it if the Omarchy shell runs on a different machine than the BeeEye gateway (e.g. an SSH-tunnelled or LAN address).

schema.label: Recent packets shown
schema.description: How many of the most recent packets to list in the panel.
